en: 🧹 Cleanup: removed Anti-Knockback, Anti-Fling, Anti-AFK, Auto Rejoin, AntiTP
🐛 Fix: Anti-Fling and Anti-Knockback conflicted with Fly and Speed
🐛 OneShot+ moved to a separate addon — no longer wastes CPU
✨ Added Auto Jump — jumps automatically while moving
✨ Added Click TP — click on screen to teleport (LMB)
✨ Added No Fog — removes fog without touching all lighting
✨ Added FOV Changer — slider 40–120
✨ Button ♻ Restore hidden addons
🔧 Removed Join / Hop — unreliable
🔧 AntiVoid v2: remembers last safe point
🔧 FastInteract: Safe mode (doesn't touch HoldDuration)
